import java.util.*;

    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid = new char[1000][1000];
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[1000][1000];
    static int[][] dist = new int[1000][1000];
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[1000][1000];
    static Queue<Node> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[1000];
    static Container[][] caps = new Container[100][100];
    static int[] leftMatch = new int[1000];
    static int[] rightMatch = new int[1000];
    static int[] color = new int[1000];

    static class Node {
        int i, j, no;
    }

    static class Container {
        int[] no = new int[1000];
        int ind;
        int fl;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        t = scanner.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = scanner.next().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid1[i] = scanner.next().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Node temp = new Node();
                    temp.i = i;
                    temp.j = j;
                    runBFS_Z(temp);
                }
            }
        }

        int marker = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid1[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) caps[i][j].fl = 1;
                    caps[i][j].ind = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        caps[i][j].no[l] = marker++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        marker = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Node temp = new Node();
                        temp.i = i;
                        temp.j = j;
                        temp.no = marker++;
                        runBFS_Digit(temp);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(getMatchingSize(marker - 1));
    }

    static boolean findPath(int node) {
        if (color[node] != 0) return false;
        color[node] = 1;

        for (int idx = 0; idx < adj[node].size(); idx++) {
            int neighbor = adj[node].get(idx);
            if (leftMatch[neighbor] == -1) {
                leftMatch[neighbor] = node;
                rightMatch[node] = idx;
                return true;
            } else if (findPath(leftMatch[neighbor])) {
                leftMatch[neighbor] = node;
                rightMatch[node] = idx;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    static int getMatchingSize(int nodeCount) {
        Arrays.fill(leftMatch, -1);
        Arrays.fill(rightMatch, -1);
        boolean changed;

        do {
            changed = true;
            Arrays.fill(color, 0);

            for (int i = 1; i <= nodeCount; i++) {
                if (rightMatch[i] == -1 && findPath(i)) {
                    changed = false;
                }
            }
        } while (!changed);

        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodeCount; i++) {
            if (rightMatch[i] != -1) count++;
        }

        return count;
    }

    static void runBFS_Digit(Node start) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dist1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        int j = start.j;
        dist1[i][j] = 0;
        bfsQueue.add(start);

        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {

            if (caps[i][j] != null && caps[i][j].fl == 1) {
                if (dist1[i][j] <= t && dist1[i][j] <= dist[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= caps[i][j].ind; k++) {
                        adj[start.no].add(caps[i][j].no[k]);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist1[i][j] >= dist[i][j]) continue;

            int k = i + 1;
            int l = j;
            if (k < n && dist1[k][l] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {
                dist1[k][l] = dist1[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;
                temp1.j = l;
                bfsQueue.add(temp1);
            }

            k = i - 1;
            l = j;
            if (k >= 0 && dist1[k][l] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {
                dist1[k][l] = dist1[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;

                bfsQueue.add(temp1);
            }

            k = i;

            if (l < n && dist1[k][l] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {
                dist1[k][l] = dist1[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;

            }

            k = i;

            if (l >= 0 && dist1[k][l] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {

                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;

                bfsQueue.add(temp1);
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS_Z(Node start) {
        int i = start.i;
        int j = start.j;
        dist[i][j] = 0;
        bfsQueue.add(start);

        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = bfsQueue.poll();
            i = temp.i;

            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;

            int k = i + 1;
            int l = j;
            if (k < n && dist[k][l] > dist[i][j] + 1) {
                dist[k][l] = dist[i][j] + 1;

            }

            k = i - 1;

            if (k >= 0 && dist[k][l] > dist[i][j] + 1) {
                dist[k][l] = dist[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;

                bfsQueue.add(temp1);
            }

            k = i;

            if (l < n && dist[k][l] > dist[i][j] + 1) {
                dist[k][l] = dist[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;

            }

                dist[k][l] = dist[i][j] + 1;
                Node temp1 = new Node();
                temp1.i = k;
                temp1.j = l;
                bfsQueue.add(temp1);
            }
        }
    }
